title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along the University Parkway, Kendall Drive, Northpark Boulevard, and Varsity Avenue corridors near CSUSB, each paired with one sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Baguettes Baked on Site
cards.subtitle: Kendall Drive corridor
cards.notes: Follow Kendall Drive to this one-block-from-campus shop when bánh mì, phở, spring rolls, or a freshly baked baguette fits the plan.
cards.short_summary: A Vietnamese sandwich shop whose official site says its baguettes are made from scratch and baked throughout the day.
cards.evidence_claim: Baguette Express is at 1689 Kendall Drive, one block from CSUSB, and serves bánh mì, phở, spring rolls, smoothies, and tea.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; consult the official site for its current Monday–Saturday service schedule.

cards.title: Drive-Through Breakfast Stop
cards.subtitle: Kendall Drive corridor
cards.notes: Take Kendall Drive to the dedicated San Bernardino location when a counter, pickup, delivery, or drive-through meal is useful.
cards.short_summary: A Kendall Drive restaurant with breakfast service and several ordering formats documented on its location page.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmer Boys lists its San Bernardino restaurant at 1766 Kendall Drive with online ordering, drive-through, pickup, and delivery.
cards.source_title: Farmer Boys — San Bernardino — Kendall Dr.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant with drive-through, pickup, and delivery; check the location page before traveling.

cards.title: Twin Kitchen Menu
cards.subtitle: Kendall Drive corridor
cards.notes: Head along Kendall Drive for a drive-through menu that combines burgers and sandwiches with tacos, burritos, and quesadillas.
cards.short_summary: This local chain’s Kendall Drive branch offers both American and Mexican fast-food menus from one stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Baker's official locator lists a San Bernardino branch at 1381 Kendall Drive and identifies the chain's American and Mexican menu categories.
cards.access_notes: Public drive-through restaurant; use the official locator to confirm the current schedule and ordering options.

cards.title: Dumplings Near Campus
cards.subtitle: Kendall Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use Kendall Drive to reach this named dumpling restaurant in the 1689 plaza; confirm current service before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A clearly addressed dumpling-house option in the commercial plaza immediately south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB's off-campus city guide lists Royal Dumpling House at 1689 Kendall Drive, Suite G, near the university.
cards.access_notes: Off-campus restaurant listed by CSUSB; verify current opening times directly before visiting.

cards.title: Grilled Rice Bowls
cards.subtitle: Kendall Drive corridor
cards.notes: Continue west on Kendall Drive to the University Village plaza when a grilled-protein rice bowl suits a quick meal break.
cards.short_summary: A bowl-focused restaurant identified by CSUSB in the Kendall Drive commercial cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB's city guide lists WaBa Grill at 2999 Kendall Drive, Unit B-20, among restaurants near campus.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant in the Kendall Drive plaza; confirm current hours and ordering methods with the business.

cards.title: Barbecue by Northpark
cards.subtitle: Northpark Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Follow Northpark Boulevard west of campus to the 1725 plaza for a barbecue meal without leaving the university district orbit.
cards.short_summary: A nationally branded barbecue restaurant in the Northpark Boulevard retail cluster beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB's city guide identifies Dickey's Barbecue Pit at 1725 Northpark Boulevard West near campus.
cards.access_notes: Public off-campus restaurant; check the operator's current location information before visiting.

cards.title: Smoothies on Northpark
cards.subtitle: Northpark Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use Northpark Boulevard to reach the 1725 plaza when a made-to-order smoothie or juice is the single reason for the trip.
cards.short_summary: A smoothie destination sharing the compact Northpark Boulevard commercial cluster near CSUSB.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB's city guide lists Jamba Juice at 1725 Northpark Boulevard West, Suite 2, near campus.
cards.access_notes: Public smoothie shop listed in CSUSB's city guide; confirm current service details directly.

cards.title: A New Varsity Avenue Stop
cards.subtitle: Varsity Avenue–University Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Turn from University Parkway onto Varsity Avenue for dine-in, carry-out, drive-through, or mobile ordering at this 2024 location.
cards.short_summary: A recently opened restaurant at the freeway-facing end of the University Parkway corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A's location page places this restaurant at 4312 North Varsity Avenue and documents dine-in, carry-out, drive-through, and delivery service.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant, closed Sundays; its official page provides current service-specific hours.

cards.title: Charbroiled Burgers
cards.subtitle: University Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Stay on University Parkway for a straightforward burger stop whose official page supports breakfast, lunch, and dinner service.
cards.short_summary: A directly documented fast-food destination on the main approach between Interstate 215 and CSUSB.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl's Jr. identifies its restaurant at 4424 University Parkway and describes breakfast, lunch, and dinner offerings.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant on University Parkway; consult the official location page for current availability.

cards.title: Cane-Juice Drinks
cards.subtitle: University Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Stop along University Parkway for sugarcane-based drinks and food; use the direct ordering page to review the current menu first.
cards.short_summary: An independent drink-and-food counter with a directly documented University Parkway address.
cards.evidence_claim: Hung Up on Cane's direct Toast ordering page identifies the business at 4235 University Parkway, Suite 102, and displays its food and drink menu.
cards.access_notes: Public food-and-drink shop; review its direct ordering page for current menu access and availability.
